_comment: KHANDAQ (audit 2026-08-21, K-04) — the desktop's bundled third-party inventory.
The desktop ships Qt 5.12.12 and OpenSSL 1.1.1w. OpenSSL 1.1.1 has been past End Of Life since
2023-09-11 and receives no public security fixes; Qt 5.12's extended LTS ended 2021-12-05. That is
lifecycle risk rather than a proven remote exploit, and it cannot be fixed by a version bump: Qt
5.12 cannot link OpenSSL 3, so the exit is the migration scoped in
What DID exist before this file: a prose comment at the top of windows-build.yaml, which had
already drifted (it said libvpx 1.14.0 while download_vpx.sh pins 1.14.1), and a version-free
table in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md. Neither was checkable.
`pin_file` + `pin_var` are the load-bearing fields: scripts/check-bundled-deps-eol.py reads the
real value out of the real build script and fails when this file disagrees, so the inventory
cannot drift the way the prose comment did. `waiver` is the vulnerability-backport policy the
audit asked for, in a form that EXPIRES and re-fails instead of rotting.
Regenerate versions after a bump:  python3 scripts/check-bundled-deps-eol.py --fix-versions

components.name: ffmpeg
components.note: 4.4 is an upstream LONG-TERM branch that still receives point releases (4.4.8), so it is not EOL — but it is the oldest maintained line and worth revisiting with the Qt 6 work.

components.name: libexpat
components.purpose: XML parsing in the Windows bundle
components.min_version_source: CVE-2024-8176 (improper restriction of XML entity expansion depth) is fixed in libexpat 2.7.0. 2.4.1 (May 2021) also predates the Feb-Mar 2022 CVE wave fixed across 2.4.5-2.4.7. Upstream is at 2.8.3 as of 2026-08-21.
components.note: Unlike OpenSSL and Qt, nothing structural blocks this bump — it is a standalone XML parser built as its own Docker layer. It is waived only because no desktop build has been produced or tested here.

waiver.reason: No Qt/Docker toolchain was available to build and smoke-test a bumped expat, and shipping an unbuilt bump is worse than shipping a recorded, dated one. This is the cheapest of the three waivers to clear.

components.name: openssl
components.purpose: TLS for Qt Network, and -lcrypto for SQLCipher
components.eol_source: OpenSSL Project — the 1.1.1 branch reached End Of Life on 11 Sep 2023; 1.1.1w is its final release.

waiver.reason: Qt 5.12 cannot link against OpenSSL 3. The only exit is the Qt 6 migration scoped in DESIGN-qt6-openssl3-migration-scope.md; bumping OpenSSL alone would break the Qt build and the runtime-DLL allowlist in khandaq-desktop/windows/cross-compile/build.sh, which hard-codes the 1_1 SONAME.

components.name: qt
components.purpose: application framework; Qt Network is the TLS consumer
components.eol_source: Qt 5.12 LTS: standard support ended 2020-12-05, extended commercial LTS ended 2021-12-05.

waiver.reason: Migrating to Qt 6 is a scoped project, not a version bump — see DESIGN-qt6-openssl3-migration-scope.md. It is also the blocker on retiring OpenSSL 1.1.1.

components.name: sodium
components.note: 1.0.18 (2019) is old for a crypto primitive; 1.0.20 is current upstream. Not EOL, no waiver, but it should move with the next desktop toolchain refresh.

components.name: sqlcipher
components.note: 4.5.0 (2021) encrypts the local profile database; upstream is on 4.6.x.
